description_en: Invokes the UpdateAcceleratorAutoRenewAttribute operation to modify the auto-renewal property of an Alibaba Cloud Global Accelerator (GA) instance
description_zh: 调用UpdateAcceleratorAutoRenewAttribute接口修改全球加速实例的自动续费属性
kebab_example: aliyun ga update-accelerator-auto-renew-attribute --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --accelerator-id ga-bp17frjjh0udz4qz0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateAcceleratorAutoRenewAttribute

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the Alibaba Cloud Global Accelerator (GA) instance. Valid value: cn-hangzhou
parameters.help_zh: 全球加速实例所属的地域ID，仅取值：cn-hangzhou
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the value, but you must ensure that it is unique among different requests. The client token can contain only ASCII characters. If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the RequestId of the API request as the ClientToken. The RequestId of each API request is unique
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一，ClientToken仅支持ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId不一样
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The name of the Alibaba Cloud Global Accelerator (GA) instance. The name must be 1 to 128 characters in length, and can contain digits, underscores (_), and hyphens (-). It must start with a letter or a Chinese character
parameters.help_zh:
全球加速实例的名称。

名称长度为1~128个字符，以大小写字母或中文开头，可包含数字、下划线（_）或短划线（-）
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the Alibaba Cloud Global Accelerator (GA)
parameters.name: accelerator_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether auto-renewal is enabled. Valid values:

true: yes.

false (default): no.

AutoRenew and RenewalStatus cannot both be empty
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启了自动续费。取值：

true：是。

false（默认值）：否。

AutoRenew和RenewalStatus不能同时为空
parameters.name: auto_renew

parameters.help_en:
The auto-renewal status of the Alibaba Cloud Global Accelerator (GA) instance. Valid values:

AutoRenewal: Auto-renewal settings.

Normal: Manual renewal.

NotRenewal: No renewal. The system no longer sends expiration reminders, but sends a non-renewal reminder three days before expiration. You can change the renewal method of an Alibaba Cloud Global Accelerator (GA) instance that is set to not renew to manual renewal (Normal), and then manually renew the instance or enable auto-renewal (AutoRenewal).

AutoRenew and RenewalStatus cannot both be empty.
The RenewalStatus parameter takes precedence over the AutoRenew parameter. If you do not specify the RenewalStatus parameter, the AutoRenew parameter is used by default
parameters.help_zh:
全球加速实例的自动续费状态。取值：

AutoRenewal：设置为自动续费。

Normal：手动续费。

NotRenewal：不再续费，系统不再发送到期提醒，只在到期前第三天发送不续费提醒。不再续费的全球加速实例可以修改成手动续费（Normal）后，再自行续费或配置为自动续费（AutoRenewal）。

AutoRenew和RenewalStatus不能同时为空。
参数RenewalStatus的优先级高于参数AutoRenew。如果不配置参数RenewalStatus，则默认以参数AutoRenew为准
parameters.name: renewal_status

parameters.help_en:
The auto-renewal duration. Unit: months.

Valid values: 1 to 12.

This parameter takes effect only when AutoRenew is set to true
parameters.help_zh:
自动续费时长。单位：月。

取值范围：1~12。

仅AutoRenew的为true时，该项才生效
parameters.name: auto_renew_duration

AcceleratorId.description_en: The instance ID of the Alibaba Cloud Global Accelerator (GA)
